verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an official MCP server in several first-party sources: a GitHub repo, the support docs and the developer docs, and a probe found a dedicated developer page. The server lets MCP-enabled clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code fetch and manage PagerDuty account data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and evidence of a hosted remote endpoint (the evidenced server is local) or detailed tool coverage.
